## Push mechanism

Live browser updates use **Server-Sent Events (SSE)** over HTTP — not WebSockets or a message broker.

| Layer | Path | Symbol(s) |
|---|---|---|
| Client subscription | `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` | `useLiveMemoRefresh`, `fetchSSEStream`, `handleSSEEvent` |
| HTTP endpoint | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` | `RegisterSSERoutes` → route `GET /api/v1/sse`; handler `handleSSE` |
| Wire format | same file | `Content-Type: text/event-stream`; payloads as `data: {json}\n\n`; heartbeats as `: heartbeat\n\n` |
| Auth | same file | `auth.NewAuthenticator` + Bearer token in `Authorization` header |
| Route registration | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` | `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` calls `RegisterSSERoutes(gwGroup, s.SSEHub, ...)` |

The client connects to `/api/v1/sse`, parses `data:` lines as JSON, and invalidates React Query caches on memo/reaction change events.

---

## Hub implementation path

### Core hub (pub/sub)

**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`

| Symbol | Role |
|---|---|
| `SSEEventType` | Event type enum |
| `SSEEventMemoCreated`, `SSEEventMemoUpdated`, `SSEEventMemoDeleted`, `SSEEventMemoCommentCreated`, `SSEEventReactionUpserted`, `SSEEventReactionDeleted` | Event constants |
| `SSEEvent` | Payload struct (`Type`, `Name`, `Parent`; server-only `Visibility`, `CreatorID`) |
| `SSEEvent.JSON()` | Marshals event to JSON |
| `SSEClient` | Per-connection buffered channel (`events chan []byte`) |
| `SSEHub` | Hub struct (`clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}`) |
| `NewSSEHub()` | Constructor |
| `SSEHub.Subscribe(userID, role)` | Registers client |
| `SSEHub.Unsubscribe(c)` | Removes client |
| `SSEHub.Close()` | Shuts down all clients |
| `SSEHub.Broadcast(event)` | Fan-out to eligible clients (non-blocking; drops on full buffer) |
| `SSEClient.canReceive(event)` | Visibility-based delivery filter |

### SSE helpers

**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go`

| Symbol | Role |

|---|---|

| Path | Symbol | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` | `APIV1Service.SSEHub` field | Hub owned by API service |
| same | `NewAPIV1Service` | `SSEHub: NewSSEHub()` |
